verdicts.rationale: Both are tests for heteroskedasticity but differ in their approach, with the Goldfeld-Quandt test using variance comparison across subsamples.
Both are diagnostic procedures for detecting heteroskedasticity, providing alternative testing strategies.
Both test for heteroskedasticity, where the Goldfeld-Quandt test relies on data ordering while the White test uses squared residuals and cross-products.
The Goldfeld-Quandt test uses an F-statistic ratio to compare error variances, directly applying F-test principles.
